# Magic vs BELAY: pricing and coverage compared (2026)


David Merriman


Co-founder, Magic


Updated Oct 2026


Table of Contents


9 min read


Published by Magic. Pricing and service information checked October 20, 2026 against the providers’ pages linked below. Confirm current terms with each provider.


## Quick summary


Magic and BELAY are both fully managed services. Both help recruit and match assistants and provide ongoing support. Three things separate them: where the assistants are based, how the pricing works, and whether anyone covers the work when your assistant is away.


Magic’s Virtual Assistant plan is $360 a week for 40 hours ($9 an hour). Its Executive Assistant plan is $540 a week for 40 hours ($13.50 an hour) and includes[Magic 24/7](https://getmagic.com/magic-247-assistant/) . Magic Teams is $540 a week per assistant, with custom hiring and training and discounts at scale.


BELAY quotes each client after a consultation, so the cost varies and you find out yours on the call. Ask BELAY for a quote covering your required hours and tasks.
Consider BELAY if a US-based assistant is a requirement. If you don’t, compare Magic’s Virtual Assistant and Executive Assistant plans; the Executive Assistant plan includes backup coverage.


What we found


- **Magic publishes separate VA and EA prices.** At 40 hours a week, a Virtual Assistant is $360 a week and an Executive Assistant is $540. BELAY provides a custom quote.
- **Magic includes backup coverage.** Full-time Executive Assistant plans come with[Magic 24/7](https://getmagic.com/magic-247-assistant/) , a shared pool that picks up work when your assistant is unavailable. Ask BELAY to confirm its arrangements for assistant absences; those details are not specified in the sources reviewed.
- **Magic pays for its assistants’ AI tools.** Every assistant gets access to leading LLMs and[training](https://getmagic.com/feature/training/) on how to use them, at no extra charge to you.
- **BELAY hires in the US. Magic hires in the Philippines and Latin America.** Every Magic assistant works US hours.

## Backup when your assistant is away


Assistants take holidays, get sick, and go on leave. What happens to the work during those days is worth checking before you sign with either service.


Magic’s full-time Executive Assistant plan includes[Magic 24/7](https://getmagic.com/magic-247-assistant/) , a shared pool of assistants who pick up tasks when your dedicated assistant is unavailable. You send the request and someone handles it.


Ask BELAY how it handles absences and what coverage your quote includes. Its FAQ describes a dedicated assistant and free rematching, but does not specify an on-demand backup arrangement.


## AI tools


Every Magic assistant gets access to leading LLMs and AI tools, plus[training](https://getmagic.com/feature/training/) on how to use them before they start working with you. Magic pays for the tools.


BELAY says its assistants use AI and automation to enhance rather than replace expertise. Their site doesn’t say which tools assistants get or who pays for them, so you’d need to ask on the call.


## Vetting and training


Magic accepts the top 0.5% of applicants. BELAY describes its vetting process; the sources reviewed do not give a comparable acceptance rate.
Every Magic assistant goes through[training](https://getmagic.com/feature/training/) on AI tools before their first task for you. Ask BELAY how onboarding and tool training apply to your engagement.


## Contracts and cancellation


Magic has no long-term contract and lets you cancel at any time. Its standard plans are billed every four weeks, with weekly billing also available. BELAY describes its service as month-to-month; confirm the notice period in your agreement.


The other difference is when you commit. BELAY’s process is a sales call, then an agreement, then a discovery call. BELAY selects your assistant and introduces them at a kickoff call. With Magic you meet your assistant first, and there’s no charge until you start working together.


## Why choose BELAY


Consider BELAY if a US-based assistant is a requirement. BELAY hires in the US, across 48 states.
Magic’s assistants are in the Philippines and Latin America. All of them work US time zones.


## Why choose Magic


Consider Magic if an international remote assistant fits your needs and you want published plan prices and a dedicated weekly schedule.

- **Published selection standard.** Magic selects the top 0.5% of applicants. Providers use different candidate pools and selection measures, so their percentages are not directly comparable.
- **Trained on AI before they start.** Every assistant gets access to leading AI tools, paid for by Magic, plus[training](https://getmagic.com/feature/training/) on how to use them.
- **Backup coverage included.** Full-time Executive Assistant plans come with[Magic 24/7](https://getmagic.com/magic-247-assistant/) , so work keeps moving when your assistant is away.
- **US time zones.** Every assistant works your hours.
- **Clear pricing.** Rates are published by plan on the[pricing page](https://getmagic.com/pricing/) , with standard four-week billing and a weekly option through Sales.
- **Fully managed.** Magic handles hiring, coaching, payroll, and replacements, and your preferences carry across if you change assistant.

## Common questions


How much does Magic cost?


Magic’s Virtual Assistant plan is $360 a week for 40 hours ($9 an hour). Its Executive Assistant plan is $540 a week for 40 hours ($13.50 an hour) and includes[Magic 24/7](https://getmagic.com/magic-247-assistant/) . Magic Teams is $540 a week per assistant, with custom hiring and training and discounts at scale. The prices shown use standard four-week billing. Weekly billing is also available through Sales at different rates. Part-time plans are available; contact Magic for current rates and hours. There is no charge until you start working with your assistant. See the[pricing page](https://getmagic.com/pricing/) .


How much does BELAY cost?


BELAY provides a custom quote. Its FAQ says support typically starts at 45 hours per month. Ask for a quote matching your required role, hours, and tasks. See[BELAY’s FAQ](https://belaysolutions.com/faq) .


Where are Magic assistants based?


Magic assistants are in the Philippines and Latin America, and all of them work US time zones. BELAY hires in the US, across 48 states.


What can a Magic assistant do?


Magic assistants cover executive and administrative work across more than a hundred task types, including inbox and calendar management, travel, research, project coordination, bookkeeping support, and personal tasks. See what an[executive assistant](https://getmagic.com/executive-assistant/) handles day to day. Magic isn’t built for senior specialist roles like a lead developer or designer.


How selective is Magic’s hiring?


Magic accepts the top 0.5% of applicants. Every assistant who gets through goes through[training](https://getmagic.com/feature/training/) on AI tools before their first task. BELAY describes its vetting process; the sources reviewed do not give a comparable acceptance rate.


What happens when my assistant is on leave?


Magic’s full-time Executive Assistant plan includes[Magic 24/7](https://getmagic.com/magic-247-assistant/) , a shared pool of assistants who pick up tasks when your dedicated assistant is unavailable. Ask BELAY to confirm absence coverage in your quote; the sources reviewed do not specify an on-demand backup arrangement.


Do Magic assistants use AI tools?


Yes. Every Magic assistant gets access to leading LLMs and AI tools, plus[training](https://getmagic.com/feature/training/) on how to use them before they start. Magic pays for the tools. BELAY says its assistants use AI and automation, but doesn’t say which tools they get or who pays.


What happens if my Magic assistant isn’t the right fit?


Magic replaces them at no extra cost and your saved preferences carry over, so the new assistant starts with the same context. BELAY offers a free rematch under its Right-Fit Guarantee.


Can I cancel anytime?


Magic has no long-term contract and you can cancel at any time. BELAY describes its service as month-to-month; confirm the notice period in your agreement.


Which is better, Magic or BELAY?


It depends on whether you need someone based in the US. If you do, choose BELAY. If you don’t, compare Magic’s published plans with your BELAY quote. Magic’s Executive Assistant plan includes backup coverage and paid AI access.
